s1.title: Section heading still to be defined
s1.body1: This block is reserved for the content you decide on about the company, its track record or the value proposition of the development. The current text is filler and must be replaced before launch.
s1.body2: The layout comfortably holds two or three paragraphs without hurting readability. The image on the left can be swapped for a real photo of the development or a short video.

s2.title: Second content block to be completed
s2.body1: A space intended for a short, centred message: it could be a brand statement, a featured testimonial, or the purchase process explained in a few lines.
s2.body2: With no image, this section works as a visual pause between two dense blocks. Keep the text short and stick to one idea per paragraph.
